## Accumulated Context

### Decisions

Decisions are logged in PROJECT.md Key Decisions table.
Recent decisions affecting current work:

- Roadmap ordering: integration/data foundation first (everything consumes it), then trips (core value), master data, financials, documents & reports.
- Reuse existing app screens; rewire data through an adapter layer — do not rebuild working UI.
- Freight/billing rules (slabs, GST, TDS) move server-side; backend owns the math.
- Local PHP + MySQL dev backend required for build/verification; no DB secrets in the app.

### Pending Todos

None yet.

### Blockers/Concerns

- Backend mobile API has no create-trip/advance/settle endpoints — Phase 2 requires new tenant-/role-scoped write endpoints following mobile/API + ajax*/save_* + lib/ patterns.
- DB credentials are committed/embedded and passwords plaintext — hardening pass is a Phase 1 prerequisite (DATA-06).
